purpose: Teach: めど/取組み/先着/借入金/略称/一級/推察/親密

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新製品の発売、年内にめどをつけましょう
lines.en: Let's set a timeline for the new product launch by the end of the year.
lines.style: Crisp, organized pace. Leader's authority—not harsh, but purposeful. Lets the sentence land with quiet confidence. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内取組みのまとめ資料を作成中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm putting together the summary document of our internal efforts right now.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Slightly faster pace—eager to show readiness. Steady, reliable tone. No lag between her statement and his acknowledgement.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: セミナーは先着順でご案内しましょう
lines.en: Let's handle the seminar registrations on a first-come, first-served basis.
lines.style: Clear instruction, measured pace. Practical and matter-of-fact. Slight pause before the key point—giving it weight without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。借入金審査の書類が届きました
lines.en: Yes. The loan review documents came through.
lines.style: Straightforward delivery. Brief, efficient. Small acknowledgement at the start—then the factual update lands quietly. No flourish.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社名の略称、SNSで統一しましょう
lines.en: Let's standardize how we abbreviate the company name across all our social media.
lines.style: Decisive but collaborative in tone. Even pace, slightly formal register. Expectation of agreement without demanding it. Maintains authority gently.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。一級資格者を増員する予定です
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to bring on more staff members with first-class certifications.
lines.style: Professional confirmation. Slight warmth underneath the formality—showing initiative, not just compliance. Steady breath, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様のご要望を推察してご提案しましょう
lines.en: Let's anticipate what our clients need and propose solutions before they ask.
lines.style: Thoughtful, forward-leaning tone. Slower, more intentional pace than before. This is the pitch—the vision. Quiet conviction, not salesmanship.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様との親密な関係を大切にしております
lines.en: Yes. We really value maintaining those close relationships with our best clients.
lines.style: Warm sincerity breaking through the professional veneer. Slower pace. Slight softness on 'relationships'—this matters personally to him, not just procedurally. Genuine.
